//: The app calls the API directly via VITE_*_API_URL (set in Vercel env to the Caddy HTTPS domain) — NOT via rewrites. The only rewrite is the SPA fallback so client-side routes resolve to index.html. Do NOT re-add per-service /api/* rewrites: they pointed at retired Railway URLs and conflicted with the real routing.
//headers: space/Caddyfile sets these for the HF Space origin; this is the same set for the Vercel origin, which had none. frame-ancestors is 'self' (not 'none') so the app stays embeddable by its own pages — unlike the Space, Vercel is not framed by huggingface.co, but 'self' costs nothing and keeps the two origins' policies comparable. No script-src: index.html has an inline pre-paint theme script and loads Google Fonts, so a real script-src needs a nonce rollout rather than a config line.
